SpatialReference: MNI template as labelled by the authors (space-mni); exact template not stated in the release

atlas_label_AAL3v1.Description: AAL3v1 atlas label at the contact's MNI coordinate (nearest labelled voxel within 3-4 mm; fsaverage aseg white-matter fallback), looked up by the ieeg-atlas project (report/ieeg-atlas/build/coord_regions.py) on the coordinates in this file. Derived label, not given by the authors; the template variant is assumed MNI152. Coordinates here are in metres (same positions as the deposit's subject-level mm files). STN contacts lie in the subthalamic nucleus per their channel names; AAL3 has no STN label, so their lookup names the nearest AAL3 structure ('nearest<=8mm').
